## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Computational analysis by DharmaNexus identifies substantial Pali-internal text reuse, recording 91 matching passages across 29 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Extensive formulaic passages, especially in segments 10.1–14.1, recur in both parts of the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* and the *Therīgāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, as well as in numerous other poems of the Therāpadāna, including the *Lakuṇḍabhaddiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 543), the *Tikiṅkaṇipupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 493), and the *Avaṭaphaladāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 383) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also aligns brief phrasal matches with Tibetan translations of the *Ārya-amitābhavyūha-nāma-mahāyānasūtra* (D0049) and *Ārya-bodhisattvapiṭaka-nāma-mahāyānasūtra* (D0056), as well as the Chinese translation of the *Mahāparinirvāṇa-sūtra* (T 7), though these are machine alignments rather than established textual parallels [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
